messages:
Felix (AE): BlueHarbor POC done. Ran 220 qps steady with two 2min spikes to 660 qps. p50 ~32ms, p99 up to ~480ms during spike ramps. Customer asks for a short ops note explaining p99 cause and a conservative cost delta for 3x burst headroom (5min/day) for procurement. Need doc by EOD.

Dana (Eng): Posted artifacts and basic profile. Load: {"phases": [{"duration_s":600,"qps":220},{"duration_s":120,"qps":660},{"duration_s":180,"qps":220}],"avg_tokens":300}. Initial look: p99 aligns with spike starts and with synchronized replica provisioning plus a brief expansion of batch windows.

Omar (SRE): Test infra: dedicated a100-medium x3 across 2 AZs. Autoscaler hit in AZ-1 during ramp; pod ready delays ~12s correlate with tail. Recommend: min_replicas=2 per AZ, buffer_replicas=1, staggered provisioning, prewarm_count=3 with prewarm_window=90s, and limit max_batch_size during bursts. Adding a small canary route (2%) during rollout helps catch regressions. I'll add runbook PR with prewarm script.

Priya (Security): KMS note: with BYOK we measured extra per-request latency ~8-11ms depending on key region. Mitigation: envelope key caching (recommended 20-40s) reduces calls but requires documented rotation policy. I'll start vendor QA answers and include audit-log export options.

Dana (Eng): Cost delta quick ballpark: on-demand worst-case +25-30% monthly (conservative) for 3x 5min/day spikes; 12mo reserved commit ~+6-9% (buffer replicas + occasional prewarm). If they route 20% of burst to a quantized variant we can shave ~7-10% off on-demand worst-case (quality tradeoff). Will produce a 1-page with numbers and assumptions.

attach-bot: Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-poc/blueharbor/4380001234/ (heatmap.png, traces.zip, cost-sheet.xlsx)

Felix (AE): Thanks — send the one-pager and cost table here by 4pm PT and I'll forward to procurement.
